contracts.rules: All monetary amounts, account balances, charges, and refunds MUST be stored and computed as integer cents (BigInt/integer arithmetic). Formatting for display MUST strictly use formatCents(). Floating-point math is strictly forbidden for financial calculations.
prohibitedPatterns: Float or double arithmetic for prices or balances
Manual string concatenation for ruble formatting outside formatCents()

contracts.rules: Services support dual pricing: pricePer1kRub (for internal calculations) and pricePerUnitRub (for UI display with '₽ / шт'). Price resolution and discount application MUST go strictly through marketingService.calculatePrice().
prohibitedPatterns: Inline division or multiplication of pricePer1kRub outside marketingService

contracts.rules: Ledger entries are strictly append-only and immutable. System invariant User.balance == SUM(LedgerEntry.amount) MUST be preserved on all wallet mutations. User balance updates are prohibited without creating a corresponding Ledger entry within the same database transaction.
prohibitedPatterns: Mutating or deleting existing LedgerEntry records
Updating User.balance without creating a LedgerEntry in the same transaction
Inline balance increment/decrement outside WalletService or WalletOps

contracts.rules: UnifiedPaymentService.createPayment() is the single canonical entry point for creating and processing external payment transactions.
prohibitedPatterns: Direct fetch calls to external payment providers like https://api.yookassa.ru/ outside UnifiedPaymentService

contracts.rules: Partial refund calculations for unfulfilled order quantities MUST use calculatePartialRefund().
prohibitedPatterns: Inline refund formula (remains / quantity) * charge outside calculatePartialRefund()

contracts.rules: Submit buttons MUST remain enabled and visually interactive during pending/async states with active loading spinner indicators to avoid dropping user interactions. On unfulfilled conditions, onSubmit intercept triggers smooth auto-scroll to invalid fields and shake animation.
prohibitedPatterns: Setting disabled={isSubmitting} on primary CTA buttons without active spinner indicator or creating dead-zone click handlers

contracts.rules: All utility classes must reference Tailwind CSS 4 theme variables (@theme directive / CSS custom properties). Standardized colors (bg-background, text-foreground, text-primary), spacing, typography, and dark mode tokens MUST be used instead of hardcoded hex or arbitrary pixel values.
prohibitedPatterns: Raw inline style objects for theme values

contracts.rules: HeroUI v3 compound components MUST strictly use dot-notation exports (e.g. <Modal.Content>, <Modal.Header>, <Dropdown.Trigger>, <Select.Item>, <Table.Header>).
prohibitedPatterns: Legacy top-level compound component imports (e.g. import { ModalContent } from '@heroui/react')

contracts.rules: All custom select and dropdown components MUST implement the Base UI accessible select pattern with full ARIA semantics, children render props on SelectValue to map CUIDs to human-readable strings, keyboard navigation, and collision-aware overlay positioning.
prohibitedPatterns: Unaccessible div-based select menus lacking ARIA attributes
Raw CUID rendering in SelectValue without children render prop

contracts.rules: Form field validation errors MUST be rendered directly beneath the corresponding input field using dedicated error micro-copy slots with role='alert'. Global form errors MUST be rendered directly above the primary submit button.
prohibitedPatterns: Detached alert toasts as the sole error indicator
Errors placed far from action buttons

contracts.rules: Admin route and action authorization MUST strictly use requireStaffPermission() with explicit tenantId boundaries.
